review.en: Fang Hongjian comes home from Europe with a fake degree and drifts through love, a provincial college and marriage in the late 1930s. Qian Zhongshu, a scholar of immense reading, fills every page with similes sharp enough to quote. The comedy of vanity and small cowardice is brilliant; under it lies a sad, clear view of how people trap themselves.
review.zh: 方鸿渐带着一张假文凭从欧洲回国，在恋爱、内地的大学和婚姻之间随波逐流。钱锺书学识渊博，满纸妙喻，几乎句句可以摘引。写虚荣与怯懦的喜剧精彩之极，底下却是对人如何自困的清醒而悲凉的观察。他唯一的长篇小说。
